limits: Inherited arrays retain one complete owner. Missing stages or relic quality remain unknown.
Relic reward-manifest identities are links, not decoded reward tables or reward probabilities.
Relic ERA/CATEGORY placeholders use explicit same-region language tags, retaining template and arguments; missing arguments produce null, never a resource-name guess.
Ability metadata and arcane rank/compatibility metadata are not complete scripted combat mechanics.
Booster pack probability and rarity fields are raw native inputs, not normalized final drop chances. Focus metadata does not evaluate scripted rank effects.
Job manifests retain ordered candidate pools and tier reward identities; the selection algorithm and reward probabilities are separate inputs.
Challenge display keys follow JobLib, not generator deduplication; localized candidates require the board-specific prefix binding. RequiredCount is not inferred when absent.
Syndicate alignments and titles retain their complete declaring owner; absence is not zero or an empty array.

en.description:
Hey. I think you know where you have to go. I will stay here, I will watch her, them, everyone. I'll be waiting for you to get answers and come back to us. Whatever happens in that year, whatever makes it so important, figure it out. 

Okay, I guess you should really get going. 

Please find him. 

- Operator

P.S i don't know how to prove it, but it really is me, not… it. Remember our meal on the Zariman?

zh.description:
嘿。我想你知道你得去哪里。我会留在这里，我会看着她，看着他们，看着每个人。我会等你得到答案然后回来找我们。无论那一年发生了什么，无论它有多重要，都要弄清楚。

好吧，我想你真的应该走了。

请找到他。

- 指挥官

备注：我不知道如何证明，但写下这条消息的确实是我，而不是……它。还记得我们在扎里曼号上吃的饭吗？

en.description:
Well met, indeed!

For completing my mini-adventure most foul, I bequeath unto thee this art most wonderful. Go forth, do with it what thou will! Adorn thine space with its colours, should ye find it suitable.

(AKA: IDK, it's cool, tape it to your wall or something.)

- Your Most Honorable Fablemaster

(PS: Still sorry about the whole… YEEeeeaAaaaah…)
en.name: WELL MET, ADVENTURER!

zh.description:
确实，幸会！ 

鉴于你已完成我这场邪恶的小小冒险，我特意将这幅绝妙之作送给你。拿去吧，随你处置！若是合适，便用它的色彩装点你的居所吧。 

（也就是说：我不造，反正挺酷的，拿胶带贴墙上之类的吧。） 

——你最尊贵的寓言主持人 

（对了：关于那整件……呀啊啊啊啊啊啊，还是很抱歉。）
zh.name: 幸会，冒险者！

en.description:
this is a top secret briefing from beckett central command

your mission, if you choose to accept it, is to rendezvous with agent amir at 00.00 PRECISELY

at which point, you MUST complete OPERATION K155 if you wish to SAVE CIVILIZATION AS WE KNOW IT…

or not, y’know… that’s cool too
<3
en.name: Operation K155 is GO GO GO

zh.description:
这是贝克特中央指挥部发出的绝密简报

如果你选择接受这个任务，就得在 00.00 时整与特工阿米尔会合

届时，如果你想拯救我们所知的文明，你必须完成 Q1nQ1n 行动……

不做也可以，你知道的……那也没关系
<3
zh.name: Q1nQ1n 行动开始

en.description:
Hiii!

It’s traditional to kiss your beloved on New Year’s Eve for luck. The Hex need all the luck they can get, so we ought to do a lot of kissing, don’t you agree?

They’re counting on us! Don’t be late!

(love you love you LOVE YOU)

Aoi
en.name: IMPORTANT!

zh.description:
嗨！

按照传统，在除夕夜亲吻心爱的人可以带来好运。六人组很需要好运，所以我们应该多亲几下，你说对吧？

他们等着我们呢！别迟到了！

（爱你爱你爱你）

碧
zh.name: 重要信息！

en.description:
Tenno,

As I adjust to the era in which I have awakened, I note with alarm the reappearance of 'Archons', a foe we have not seen since the Sentient War.

Several Archon Shards were retrieved from the battlefields. The Orokin demanded Albrecht Entrati explore the potential inherent in them, a task he immediately delegated to me.

The Necraloid has shown me some examples of Kermerros's work with Shards. Impressive. I believe I can improve upon it, however.

You may acquire the relevant Segment from the Cavia at your convenience.

Loid
en.name: Pursuant to the study of Archon Shards

zh.description:
天诺战士，

当我努力适应我所醒来的这个时代时，我惊讶地注意到"执刑官"的重现，这可是自灵煞战争以来我们再也没有见到过的敌人。

一些执刑官源力石从战场上被缴获。奥罗金命令阿尔布雷希特·英择谛去研究它们的内在潜能，而他迅速地把这个任务分派给了我。

殁世械灵向我展示了克梅罗斯对源力石的一些应用。令人印象非常深刻。但我相信我可以进一步完善它。

你可以在方便的时候从科维兽那里获取相关模块。

洛德
zh.name: 基于执刑官源力石的研究成果

en.description:
Hey.

You changed my life forever, in the best of ways. I still can't believe you and I found each other.

Here's to seeing in the New Year together, and the promise of many more to come.

With all my love, 

your Arthur.
en.name: Happy New Year, darling.

zh.description:
嘿。 

你以最美好的方式永远改变了我的生活。我仍然不敢相信你我找到了彼此。 

让我们一起迎接新年，并期待未来还有更多美好时光。 

带着我全部的爱， 

你的亚瑟。
zh.name: 新年快乐，亲爱的。

en.description:
Drifter,

Entrati had backup plans, and four of them just came knocking. Now that the old Round Table bar’s opened its doors again, we can afford to be hospitable. 

Hendricks and Volkov seem to know what they’re doing, at least. I’ve always respected the Libertatian military, even if they do tend to show up late to the party. 

I don’t even know where to start with the smart-arse kid and the rock prophet, though. 

Once I'm satisfied that we're secure enough here, I may well ask you to handle them.

Arthur
en.name: Newcomers

zh.description:
漂泊者，

英择谛有备用计划，其中四个刚刚来敲门。现在老圆桌酒吧又开门了，我们可以热情款待他们了。 

至少亨德里克斯和沃尔科夫似乎知道他们在做什么。就算自由军总是在派对中迟到，我还是挺尊敬他们的。 

不过，我实在是不知道该怎么应付这个自作聪明的小屁孩和摇滚先知。 

一旦我确保我们这里足够安全，我可能会让你来搞定他们。

亚瑟
zh.name: 新来者

en.description:
HEEYYY look at you!! Congrats on beating caliber chicks!! here's some cool prizes for your efforts. what's an arcade without prizes, right?! *SO SHINY* lol

-the l33t arcade master himself AMIR

PS: don't even think about coming for my top score, that takes like AT LEAST five loops of the game to do and that top score IS ALL MINE DO YOU HEAR ME?! MINE!!
en.name: CONGRATS ON BEATING CALIBER CHICKS!!

zh.description:
嘿嘿，看看你！！恭喜你打通了《火力女兵》！！这有一些超酷的奖品，奖励你付出的努力。没有奖品的游戏厅算什么地方，对吧？！*好闪啊*，哈哈

-顶尖街机高手本人阿米尔

PS：别想挑战我的高分，那分得至少得玩五轮才能达到，而且那个最高分全都是我的，明白了吗？！是我的！！
zh.name: 恭喜你打通了《火力女兵》！！

en.description:
WHOAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAAA. you beat Ollie's Crash Course in 1:30?!?!?!?!

pretty soon you won't need a bike either lmao

here's your AWESOME L3WT, you l33t I-I4XXX0|2, you

-a (super impressed) AMIR
en.name: NYRROOOOOOOOOOM!!! LOOK AT YOU GO!!

zh.description:
哇塞。你只用了 1 分 30 秒就通关《奥利的极速赛道》了？！？！？！？！

很快你可能连摩托车都不需要了，笑死

这是给你的超棒战利品，你这个 HeiKeD@Shen

——一个（超级印象深刻的）阿米尔
zh.name: 嗡——！！！看你飙的！！

en.description:
y'know when i read about the whole King Corgi thing on a caliber chicks message board I thought the whole thing was just one massive prank because I hadn't ever been able to unlock it but LOOK AT YOU!! YOU DID IT!! CONGRATS!! enjoy the shiny L3WT!

... I'm not jealous at all... nope... not in the slightest...

-a (okay very jealous) AMIR
en.name: WHOA!! YOU ACTUALLY DID IT!

zh.description:
你知道吗，当我在《火力女兵》论坛上看到整个金·柯基的事情时，我还以为那只是一个大恶搞，因为我一直解锁不了它，结果看看你！！你做到了！！恭喜！！好好享受那个闪亮的奖励吧！

……我一点都不嫉妒……不嫉妒……一点也不……

-一个（其实超嫉妒的）阿米尔
zh.name: 哇哦！！你真的做到了！

en.description:
Tenno, the Warframe Qorvex was designed by my Albrecht's own hand, to protect the chosen Operator from the hazards of his laboratory. This design is yours by right.

I intend to keep the promise I made to him. When the time is right and the equipment repaired, I will assist you to travel back to the past, to the pivotal year of 1999. 

Perhaps, between us, we may change history.

Loid
en.name: For the Tenno

zh.description:
天诺战士，辐能堡垒战甲是由我的阿尔布雷希特亲手设计的，用来保护被选中的指挥官免受他实验室的危害。这个设计理应属于你。

我打算履行我对他的承诺。一旦时机成熟，设备修复，我将协助你回到过去，回到关键的 1999 年。

也许，我们两个，可以改变历史。

洛德
zh.name: 致天诺战士

en.description:
The Syndicates need your help to complete a mission. 

Acquire Abyssal Beacons from any Syndicate enclave. 

Which Syndicate you support is entirely your choice.

|LOTUS_NAME|
en.name: SUBJECT: The Syndicates Need Help

zh.description:
集团需要你的帮助来完成任务。 

请从任意集团据点中获取深渊信标。 

你支持哪个集团完全取决于你的选择。

|LOTUS_NAME|
zh.name: 主题：集团需要帮助

en.description: Tenno. Please. The Leverian desperately needs your help. Come see me in DANTE'S LEVERIAN, as soon as possible.
en.name: I have made a tremendous mistake…

zh.description: 天诺战士。拜托了。莱弗博物馆迫切需要你的帮助。请尽快来缮写士的莱弗博物馆见我。
zh.name: 我犯了一个天大的错误……

en.description:
Drifter,

The menace of ‘NECI RUSALKA' is now contained. The tale she attempted to weave is forever sundered from the Canon. She shall fester in an apocryphal Spiral all of her own. 

We are satisfied.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Further Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
漂泊者，

"内奇·鲁莎卡"的威胁如今已被遏制。她试图编织的故事将永远与正典隔绝。她将在她自己伪造的复眠螺旋中溃烂。 

我们很满意。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的另一个谕令

en.description:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

DUVIRI IS IN GRAVE PERIL. 

While you were off on your FRIVOLOUS VENTURES the Lost Island of Scholar's Landing returned, bringing with it that MENACE of the VOID of which the Scholar spoke.

That SHE-DEMON has usurped Our Throne. She must be STOPPED.

I await you on board the ‘Zariman' for a most urgent conference.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

双衍王境处境危急。 

在你进行那些无聊的冒险时，失落的儒临地卷土重来，带来了学者提到过的虚空威胁。

那个女恶魔篡夺了我们的王位。必须阻止她。

我在扎里曼号上等你来参加一场紧急会议。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的谕令

en.description:
To the erstwhile traitor and conspirator known by the alias ‘Drifter':

That profane monstrosity of which the Scholar spoke has sought to claim our throne. It wears a face and puppets a body that knows you.

We have confined it in the Apocrypha, the realm of Untold Stories, but you now have a duty to keep it there.

If it gains sufficient power, its story will supplant ours!

Seek its heretical tale, ‘The Triumph of Dust'. Sever it from the true tales of Duviri.

His Radiant and Eternal Majesty, 

DOMINUS THRAX
en.name: A Missive From His Majesty DOMINUS THRAX

zh.description:
致化名为"漂泊者"的昔日叛徒和阴谋家：

那位学者所言的亵渎之物正企图夺取我们的王座。它戴着一张假面，操纵着一个了解你的躯体。

我们把它囚禁在伪典，那些不为人知的故事里，但你现在有责任让它留在那里。

如果它获得足够的力量，它的故事将会取代我们的！

寻找它的异端故事，"尘埃的胜利"。把它和双衍王境的真实故事分开。

荣耀而永恒的陛下， 

士魂大帝
zh.name: 士魂大帝陛下的谕令

en.description:
Hello, my darling.

I wonder: how would you feel about spending a moment or two in one another’s company around midnight tonight?

It’s tradition, after all.

I promise not to be on my best behaviour.

Love always,

E. x
en.name: A New Year’s invitation

zh.description:
你好，亲爱的。

我在想：今晚午夜时分，你愿意和我一起共度时光吗？

毕竟，这是一种传统。

我保证我不会表现得太规矩。

永远爱你，

埃.亲亲
zh.name: 新年邀约

en.description:
Tenno,

Recently, I have been plagued by strange visions of the Infestation. They are warnings from Koumei herself. I am sure of it.

Kruna metta, come see me in Cetus. Together, we can overcome a terrible fate.

Be well,
Saya
en.name: Strange Visions

zh.description:
天诺战士，

最近，我一直被关于感染者的奇怪异象所困扰。这是来自御命织姬本人发出的警告。我确信这一点。

我请求你，来希图斯找我。我们可以一起战胜这可怕的命运。

保重，
萨娅
zh.name: 奇特的异象

en.description:
FRIENDS! INVICTIANS! COUNTRY-PEOPLES! Lend me your ears!

Today on this day of… whatever-the-hell-ass loop we're in, I, your most honorable Fablemaster, am proud to announce the Grand Opening of the Dominion of Höllvandeim! 

(Previously known as the Internet Cafe upstairs.)

If thy wishes to begin a new journey into strange and mysteriously lands, venture forth and - eh - summon thy loyal servant with the - um - Enchanted Bell of Fablemastery!

…Yeah just go upstairs and ring the bell if you wanna make a character and get this party started.

Fare thee well, until we speak again!

- Fablemaster Amir
en.name: Hail, Adventurer!

zh.description:
朋友们！不败者们！还有各位乡亲父老！请听我一言！ 

在今天——这个……管它是什么鬼循环的日子里——我，你们最敬重的寓言主持人，郑重宣布：霍凡德姆王国盛大开国！ 

（以前叫楼上的网吧。） 

若诸位有意踏上一段通往奇异与神秘之地的全新旅程，便请勇敢前行，并——呃——以那……寓言主持人的魔法铃铛，召唤诸位忠诚的仆从！ 

……好吧，总之想创建角色、开始跑团的话，就上楼摇铃。 

愿诸位一路顺风，后会有期！ 

——寓言主持人 阿米尔
zh.name: 冒险者，你好！

en.description:
Hey.

Heard you been grubbing around in the Zariman's backyard. That little tinpot 'kingdom'.

Well, in my extensive downtime, I've been having thoughts about weapons. How I could upgrade 'em. Give 'em a sprinkle of Void magic. And guess what? The Void did what the Void does. Took my ideas and made them real. How about that.

So if you've picked up a... let's call it an Incarnon Genesis, why not? An Incarnon Genesis, bring it to me and I'll get it installed for ya.

Slaughter awaits.
Cavalero

PS. Yonta says I need to say this very clearly: I cannot adapt a weapon you do not own. I will need both the Incarnon Genesis AND the weapon it applies to. Understood? I am not running a charity here.
en.name: Incarnon Genesis

zh.description:
嘿。

听说你在扎里曼号的后院一通乱翻。那个小锡罐"王国"。

嗯，在大量的闲暇时光中，我一直对武器有所思考。我该如何升级它们。给它们一点虚空魔法。你猜怎么着？虚空做了虚空所做的事。把我的想法变成了现实。你觉得怎么样。

所以，如果你捡到一个……我们称之为「灵化之源」的东西，为什么不试试看呢？ 一个灵化之源，把它带给我，我会帮你安装到位。

让我们屠戮以待。
卡瓦莱罗

补充一点。扬塔说我需要说得很清楚：我无法改装你未拥有的武器。我需要灵化之源和它所适用的武器。听懂了吗？我不是在这儿开慈善机构的。
zh.name: 灵化之源

en.description:
Hey.

On behalf of all the Hex, I wanted to wish you Happy New Year. 

This place is your home, and we all consider you family. 

We're all thinking of you tonight. Especially Kalymos.

All the best, mate.

Arthur
en.name: Happy New Year from us all

zh.description:
嘿。

我代表整个六人组祝你新年快乐。 

这里是你的家，我们都把你当家人。 

今晚我们都在想你。尤其是卡利莫斯。

祝你一切顺利，伙计。

亚瑟
zh.name: 我们祝大家新年快乐

en.description:
Tenno are such arrogant, undisciplined children!

Mommy Lotus might spare the rod, but not ME! Every siphoned drop of the Old Blood makes my fortress grow stronger. Sweet, sweet Kuva!

Be on your best behavior, little one. You KNOW what you did to my sister. My Kuva Liches can make sure you get what you deserve!

Your Undying Queen
en.name: Spare the Rod

zh.description:
天诺真是一群傲慢又不守规矩的孩子！

你的莲麻麻可能会放过你，但我不会！每一滴远古之血都会让我的堡垒变得更加坚固。香香甜甜的赤毒！

小家伙，好好表现。你心里很清楚你对我姐姐做了什么。我的赤毒玄骸一定会让你自食其果！

你不朽的女王
zh.name: 不打不成器

en.description:
Hey

New year is almost here and I am alone except for my bebecitos 

Make it right

You know where to find me

Te amo, mi corazón

Your Lettie
en.name: Happy New Year

zh.description:
嘿

新年快到了，除了我的小宝贝们，我一个人 

请纠正这种情况

你知道在哪里可以找到我

我爱你，我的心肝

你的莱蒂
zh.name: 新年快乐

en.description:
Something's been nagging at me for a while. It started as a little thing, but it just wouldn't go away. How come the Temple Warframe has my name? How come they have a guitar called Lizzie, too?

Temple was my stage persona. The me I wanted to be. And Lizzie is unique. I couldn't figure it out.

Until you brought me and Lizzie together in harmony, and I finally understood.

This change that's happening in me? It can't be stopped. I'm going to transform completely one day.

And that's okay. Because the Warframe from your time - 'Temple' - it's me. One and the same. The Warframe that Ballas was too scared to build, because rebellion was built into its DNA.

You see, Drifter, I go where I'm needed. I stick it to the man in Ludston, Cemaria, Höllvania... and I know I need to do it in Pluto Terminus, too, many many years from now.

I mean, if the Technocyte Coda can survive to your time, why not me?

Kaya's helped me figure it all out. There's a comet that leaves the System and gets back just in time for the Tenno Insurrection. That's where I'll hibernate. Lizzie will make sure I don't oversleep.

When Octavia hits the beat and the drums kick in, I'll be there.

Waiting in the sky, come back to join the children of the revolution.

See you!

Flare/Temple
en.name: I Figured It Out

zh.description:
有些事情困扰我很久了。一开始只是一件小事，但我控制不住一直去想。 赤焰狂歌战甲怎么会有我的名字？他怎么也有一把叫丽兹的吉他？

 赤焰狂歌是我的舞台形象。是我想成为的那个人。而丽兹是独一无二的。这一点我无法想明白。

直到你解释了我和丽兹之间的调和关系，我才终于明白。

我身上发生的这种变化？这是不可逆的。总有一天我会彻底改变。

没关系。因为你们那个时代的战甲——" 赤焰狂歌"——就是我。一模一样。拜勒斯不敢建造这架战甲，因为反抗与叛逆刻在了他的基因中。

你看，漂泊者，我有很多地方要去。拉德斯顿、赛玛莉亚、霍瓦尼亚，这些地方都有我反抗权威的事迹……我知道，在遥远的未来，我也会在宇宙的尽头继续我的事业。

我的意思是，如果科技细胞终幕者可以存活到你的时代，为什么我不能？

卡娅帮我弄清楚了一切。有一颗彗星离开了始源星系，刚好赶在天诺战士起义之前回来。我会在那里进入冷冻舱。 丽兹会确保我不会睡过头。

当吟游歌者打出节拍，鼓声响起时，我就会归来。

从天而降，加入革命的浪潮。

再见！

弗莱尔 / 赤焰狂歌
zh.name: 我想明白了

en.description:
Mon miracle,

Thank you for showing me what I would have believed to be otherwise truly impossible. And proving to me that there is hope, even for those of us who are the most shattered.

Forever yours,
- Lyon
en.name: Relive a memory.

zh.description:
Mon miracle，

谢谢你让我看到了我原本认为根本不可能的事情。也谢谢你向我证明，即使是最破碎的人，也依然有希望。

永远爱你的，
——里昂
zh.name: 重温一段回忆。

en.description:
Hey.

You changed my life forever, in the best of ways. I still can't believe you and I found each other.

Here's to seeing in the New Year together, and the promise of many more to come.

With all my love, 

your Arthur.
en.name: Happy New Year, darling.

zh.description:
嘿。 

你以最美好的方式永远改变了我的生活。我仍然不敢相信你我找到了彼此。 

让我们一起迎接新年，并期待未来还有更多美好时光。 

带着我全部的爱， 

你的亚瑟。
zh.name: 新年快乐，亲爱的。

en.description:
Thank you for this wonderful time we shared, my wolf. I shall remember it fondly. I hope you will, as well.

With love,
- Your little Marie
en.name: Relive a memory.

zh.description:
我的狼，谢谢你陪伴我度过的美好时光。我会永远珍藏这段回忆。希望你也会如此。

爱你的，
——你的小玛丽
zh.name: 重温一段回忆。

en.description:
Tenno,

Your efforts in assisting me with the Deep Archimedea program have been nothing short of spectacular.

In the name of science, you have endured conditions and thwarted foes that would daunt the strongest.

In recognition of your work, it is my honor to award you the Archimedean Eye Sumdali, representative of the Cosmos which gazes back at us, even as we gaze into it.

Necraloid
en.name: A Step Beyond Zarium Accolades

zh.description:
天诺战士，

你在协助我进行深层科研项目上的努力简直令人惊叹。

以科学的名义，你们忍受了严峻的条件，挫败了最强大的敌人。

为了表彰你的工作，我很荣幸地授予你阿基米德之眼船徽，它代表着宇宙，就像我们凝视着它一样，宇宙也在回望着我们。

殁世械灵
zh.name: 超越耀金奖章更进一步

zh.description:
同学们，请注意。熵之赤毒正在渗入扎里曼。我们一些未经授权的访客已被它控制，导致他们比平时更加具有攻击性。这也引出了我们的班级项目，我们必须立即没收这种熵之赤毒，但该如何做呢？

同学们，我们要去实地考察。在地球的青春峰顶与我汇合。
zh.name: 实地考察（无需家长同意）

en.description:
Working hard, are we? Trying to stop progress? Grineer progress? That’s my progress. Might work with Vay Hek. Vay Hek might roll over but not Tyl. Not me. Not my Tubemen. We can’t have that. No. Won’t have that.

Kill my tubemen. I make more. And more. And more. How many of you to kill? I count one.
en.name: I Am Unstoppable

zh.description:
你这么卖力？是想阻碍什么？挡住克隆尼研究的脚步？那可是我迈出的脚步！你这样对付韦·海克可能有戏。或许能唬住他，但唬不住我泰尔。也唬不住我的克隆人。我们不会让这种情况发生。不。绝对不会。_x000D_
_x000D_
杀了我的克隆人。我还能制造更多。一波一波。无穷无尽。而你们？我只要杀一个就够了。
zh.name: 我势不可挡

en.description: Here he is. The Terror of the Orokin: bottled up like a rich lady's bathwater. Or two-credit hooch. Do what you want with him. Prop a door open, bury him twenty feet deep. Either way, he's yours. It's up to you to make sure he never gets loose again. Hell of a day, Dreamer. Hell of a day.
en.name: Hell of a day...

zh.description: 这就是他。奥罗金人的恐惧：被装在了瓶子里，就像富婆的洗澡水，或者两块钱的烈酒，你把他怎么样都行。把门撑开，又或是把他埋到二十英尺深的地下。无论如何，他都任由你处置。你要确保他再也不会跑掉了。真是要命的一天啊，梦里人，要命的一天。
zh.name: 这一天可真要命……

en.description:
Operator,

Ordis discovered this item on a routine check of the Orbiter's inventory. It appears to be an antique of quite remarkable age!

How strange that Ordis has never seen it before. Perhaps the Operator has been on adventures that Ordis knows nothing about?

Ordis
en.name: A Curious Anomaly

zh.description:
指挥官，

奥迪斯在例行检查轨道飞行器的仓库时发现了这件物品。它似乎是一件年代相当久远的古董！

奇怪的是，奥迪斯以前从未见过它。难道指挥官曾经有过一些奥迪斯不知道的冒险经历？

奥迪斯
zh.name: 不寻常的奇物

en.description:
MUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTER 

j/k! Good job beating Ollie's Crash Course. Here's your sw33t priz3!

-the l33t arcade master himself AMIR

PS: if you wanna beat the high score you MUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTERMUSTGOFASTER
en.name: CONGRATS ON PLAYING OLLIE'S CRASH COURSE!!

zh.description:
开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点开快点

开个玩笑！干得漂亮，通关了《奥利的极速赛道》。这是你的Ch@oB@ngJi@ngPin！

——来自黑话街机大师本人阿米尔的附言：

如果你想破纪录，你必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点必须再开快点
zh.name: 恭喜通关《奥利的极速赛道》！！

en.description:
hey babes

new year is comin, u want 2 celebrate?

just u and me, private, no stress

lmk
en.name: Hey

zh.description:
嘿宝贝

新年就要到了，你想庆祝一下吗？

就我们俩，私下庆祝，没有压力

随时告诉我
zh.name: 嘿

en.description:
My love,

The future awaits us. But for now, I shall treasure this small portion of our past. I hope you shall keep it close.

Yours,
- Roathe
en.name: Relive a memory.

zh.description:
我的爱人，
未来在等着我们。但现在，我会珍惜这段短暂的回忆。希望你也能好好珍藏。

你的，
——罗瑟
zh.name: 重温一段回忆。

en.description: Tenno, I require your help.
en.name: Mystery Drones

zh.description: 天诺战士，我向你请求协助。
zh.name: 神秘无人机

en.description:
Operator,

During a routine electromagnetic wave sweep, a most distressing message was intercepted on the Corpus network. Ordis hopes nothing comes of this murderous consortium, or rather, board meeting.

Do be careful.

Your loyal Cephalon,
Ordis
en.name: Corporate Machinations

zh.description:
指挥官，

在一次例行的电磁波扫描中，从科普斯网络上截获了一条最让人不安的信息。奥迪斯希望这个凶恶的商会，或者更确切地说，董事会会议不会有什么结果。

请一定要小心。

您忠诚的中枢，
奥迪斯
zh.name: 企业阴谋

zh.description:
漂泊者，

深溯池已准备好。她安然无恙。请加入我们。

我得提醒你，你那位年轻版的自己对你抢先一步不太高兴，所以请尽快过来。

洛德
zh.name: 介入提议

en.description:
Chosen Operator. A friendly suggestion: you could do so much more with those Melee weapons of yours. I donate my wisdom on both tool and technique. Listen well.

TENNOKAI, a fighting technique fusing Void and Beastial instinct. Raw power.  While I have never used Tennokai, I understand it perfectly. Somewhat of a mind mastery. Enough so that lost materials pertaining to Tennokai have been stored just out of my reach in the Sanctum.

Tools. Papa was not one to rest, use this segment to unlock more potential for your Arsenal. The Arcane was an art and science that Papa studied well - the convexity of my bowl a magnifying glass on his research, and now your gain.

Install this segment, acquire Melee Arcanes, find Tennokai Modules, and observe the results: the swift deletion of your foes.
en.name: An Appropriate Technique?

zh.description:
被选中的指挥官。友情提示：你能用你的近战武器做多更多的事情。我把我对于工具和技术上的智慧贡献给你。听好了。

天诺气解，一种融合了虚空与兽性本能的战斗技巧。原始的力量。虽然我从未使用过天诺气解，但我却对其了如指掌。某种程度上，我是个心灵大师。以至于与天诺气解相关的丢失资料被放在我够不着的圣所。

工具。爸爸是个闲不住的人，用这个模块来为你的军械库释放更多潜力。赋能是爸爸研究得很透彻的一门艺术和科学——我的鱼缸凸面是他研究的放大镜，现在成了你的收获。

安装这个模块，获取近战赋能，找到天诺气解模块，然后观察结果：迅速消灭你的敌人。
zh.name: 一种合适的战技？

en.description:
Tenno,

Please meet me at the Necralisk as soon as you are able. This cannot wait.

Discretion is paramount. Tell nobody.

Loid
en.name: URGENT

zh.description:
天诺战士，

请尽快到殁世幽都与我会面。此事不能等待。

谨慎至关重要。不要告诉任何人。

洛德
zh.name: 紧急情况

en.description:
Hey Chip!

There’s nothing important in the transmission message and you don’t need to watch it.

-Otak
en.name: JUST A REGULAR MESSAGE ABOUT MINERALS AND STUFF

zh.description:
嘿，小翻版！

这条传输信息里没有任何重要内容，你也不需要看它。

-奥塔
zh.name: 只是条关于矿物之类的常规信息

en.description: I am Cephalon Cy. I require access to your Dry Dock. Take me there.
en.name: Awaiting Dry Dock Integration

zh.description: 我是中枢赛伊。我需要进入你的干船坞。带我过去。
zh.name: 正在等待干船坞整合
